model_annotation: The plot illustrates the trends of four different categories over a range of x-values, with the x-axis unlabeled and having eight tick marks, and the y-axis labeled with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 200,000 with tick labels at intervals of 50,000. The orange line, representing "Селско, горско и рибно стопанство" (Agriculture, forestry, and fishing), starts at around 10,000 and remains relatively stable, ending at approximately 10,000. The grey line, representing "Преработваща промишленост" (Manufacturing industry), begins at around 40,000, fluctuates, and ends at approximately 190,000. The yellow line, representing "Търговия; ремонт на автомобили и мотоциклети" (Trade; repair of automobiles and motorcycles), starts at around 20,000, remains relatively stable with minor fluctuations, and ends at approximately 20,000. The blue line, representing "Създаване и разпространение на информация и творчески продукти; далекосъобщения" (Creation and dissemination of information and creative products; telecommunications), begins at around 30,000, decreases to approximately 10,000, and then sharply increases to around 170,000.
